title: Wavelength and sharp detail
hook: Change wavelength and predict angular resolution limit.
misconception: angular resolution limit stays fixed when wavelength doubles.
objective: Apply θ ≈ 1.22λ/D to compare angular resolution limit when wavelength changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a circular aperture under the Rayleigh criterion with fixed aperture diameter, θ ≈ 1.22λ/D. When wavelength doubles, angular resolution limit becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model θ ≈ 1.22λ/D; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a circular aperture under the Rayleigh criterion with fixed aperture diameter, with a nonzero initial result. If wavelength triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on angular resolution limit?
recall.why: Apply θ ≈ 1.22λ/D under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
